beats.headline: Taught to drive in an afternoon
beats.text: Carl has about an afternoon to teach me to drive and we do not have an afternoon. The pedals are in the wrong place for my feet. There are two pedals and I have been told about half of what the right one does. And the navigation talks. It talks constantly, it does not like me, and I have privately decided that the safest policy available to me is to agree with everything Dr. Metcalf says. Zhang is on the chat with news about the other teams. I am not listening to Zhang. I am driving next.

beats.headline: He drives it through the hail
beats.text: I drove. Hail the size of fists on the shield for the whole of it, and I went slow, and I only screamed twice. At the top of the next hill the other teams are stopped and out of their vehicles, and we pull up slow beside them: the Lady Dominators, and team One Fine Pig, which is two Tigrans, a pig, and a mercenary with a mallet keeping the hail off the lot of them. I know him. Pontiff. He danced at the club until Damascus sent him back to the mercenary market, and he slapped me once for getting in the way of his routine. It stops mattering shortly, because the whole road is stopped anyway. There is a boss sitting across it.

beats.headline: He tells Dong what he saw
beats.text: We are back in the garage and Hedy is waiting at the door with her arms crossed. I jump out of the truck and tell Dong, because I thought he would want to know and because I did not think about it for long enough, that I saw Corcunda out there, and Pontiff too. Nobody told me not to. I would like it stated, for whatever it is worth, that I was only telling him the truth.

beats.headline: A bad night outside the Lady Dominators' garage
beats.text: Bad night. Splash Zone and Gluteus Maxx and Dr. Bones went to talk to Hamed and now nobody can raise them, because they are not on this floor any more. Dong is properly ill, with a debuff over him I have never seen before. I grabbed the sock to ask it what was wrong and it went for me, and then it was just gone, teleported out by the safe room, and I do not know what happened. Meanwhile the others go to the Lady Dominators' garage to get Corcunda out, and the car is already rolling out for the line before anyone gets in. I am not a soldier. I keep finding myself in the room where the soldiering happens.

beats.headline: Everyone dies in this place
beats.text: I am sitting in the corner of the garage watching Hedy do the last-minute fixes, and Pontiff is talking to me quietly. He says he would take it all back if he could, but he can't, so all he can do is make amends from here. I tell him I don't even care anymore. Everyone dies in this place. He says Dong and Corcunda are dead, yes, but the others live. Then he sees Carl in the doorway and stops talking, and Carl says they'll be back.

beats.headline: He sits this one out
beats.text: They are letting me sit this one out. Carl's new room is one big room now, playing early two-thousands rock over and over, because Samantha likes it and I am not allowed to turn it off. Some of her decorations got messed up. She is going to be mad. Carl says don't stay in his room, go to the main guild commons, go fast. So I am going fast.
